# adds_user (Data Source)

Reads an existing Active Directory user. Use it to reference users that are not managed by this Terraform configuration, for example as a `manager`, a `managed_by` owner, or a principal in an access rule.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up an existing user that Terraform does not manage, for example to use them as the
# manager or owner of objects this configuration creates.
data "adds_user" "department_head" {
  identity = "jsmith"
}

resource "adds_group" "department" {
  name       = "Department Staff"
  path       = "Contoso/Groups"
  scope      = "Global"
  managed_by = data.adds_user.department_head.distinguished_name
}

output "department_head" {
  value = {
    distinguished_name = data.adds_user.department_head.distinguished_name
    sid                = data.adds_user.department_head.sid
    enabled            = data.adds_user.department_head.enabled
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `identity` (String) Identity of the user to look up. Accepts a distinguished name, `objectGUID`, SID, `DOMAIN\name`, `sAMAccountName` or `userPrincipalName`. Reading fails if no user matches.

### Read-Only

- `account_expiration_date` (String) Date the account expires, as `YYYY-MM-DD`. Empty when the account never expires.
- `cannot_change_password` (Boolean) Whether the user is prevented from changing their password.
- `city` (String) City (`l`).
- `company` (String) Company.
- `country` (String) Country (`c`).
- `department` (String) Department.
- `description` (String) Description.
- `display_name` (String) Display name (`displayName`).
- `distinguished_name` (String) Distinguished name of the user.
- `division` (String) Division.
- `email` (String) Email address (`mail`).
- `employee_id` (String) Employee ID.
- `employee_number` (String) Employee number.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the account is enabled.
- `fax` (String) Fax number.
- `given_name` (String) First name (`givenName`).
- `home_directory` (String) Home directory path.
- `home_drive` (String) Home drive letter.
- `home_page` (String) Web page address (`wWWHomePage`).
- `home_phone` (String) Home phone number.
- `id` (String) Account `objectGUID`, stable across renames and moves.
- `initials` (String) Initials.
- `logon_workstations` (String) Workstations the user may log on to.
- `manager` (String) Distinguished name of the user's manager.
- `mobile_phone` (String) Mobile phone number.
- `name` (String) User name (the `CN`).
- `office` (String) Office location (`physicalDeliveryOfficeName`).
- `office_phone` (String) Office phone number.
- `organization` (String) Organization (`o`).
- `other_name` (String) Middle name (`middleName`).
- `password_never_expires` (Boolean) Whether the password never expires.
- `path` (String) Slash-delimited path of the container holding the user, relative to the domain root.
- `po_box` (String) Post office box.
- `postal_code` (String) Postal code.
- `profile_path` (String) Roaming profile path.
- `sam_account_name` (String) Pre-Windows 2000 logon name.
- `script_path` (String) Logon script path.
- `sid` (String) Security identifier of the user.
- `smart_card_logon_required` (Boolean) Whether smart card logon is required.
- `state` (String) State or province (`st`).
- `street_address` (String) Street address.
- `surname` (String) Last name (`sn`).
- `title` (String) Job title.
- `trusted_for_delegation` (Boolean) Whether the account is trusted for unconstrained Kerberos delegation.
- `user_principal_name` (String) User principal name.
